title: Abnormal Additions
description: Expand your default experience with all sort of not forcibly conventional things added to Minecraft
body:
_This mod is in Alpha, it is not the final result, everything is subject to change_
Abnormal Additions is a Minecraft mod made with the thought of not having to download tons of mods in order to change the game, that's why it doesn't have a main theme.

Although it doesn't have a main theme, it has an some inspirations like: The Detour Mod,The Unusual Squad's Mods,ect… It also is a mod made both seriously and for experimenting, so it could contains feature from others even though if i just take a feature i'll probably mention where it come from,if i don't, it's a coincidence

Heres some feature from the mods:

The BeeKreeper: The BeeKreeper is a creeper variant that doesn't naturally explode, it first attacks you phisically and once it took enough damages…BOOM, and the explosion spawns a certain amount fo bees that'll attack you.

 

The Amethyst Dagger: The Amethyst Dagger doesn't have a lot of damage nor it have great durability, but it has the best attack speed of the game and great enchantablity !

 

Other features too are either implemented or in the works, this mod is in Alpha and is far from complete so, it doesn't have a lot of content but content will be added over time
